source: oracles/uapki/library/uapkic/src/dstu7624.c dstu7624_cmac_self_test (case 1, programmatically extracted, not hand-transcribed). Message is 94 bytes - NOT a multiple of the 16-byte block size, so this is the only one of the three official CMAC vectors that exercises the padding branch (padding()'s 0x80 fill in cmac_final). Single-oracle (uapki only): oracles/bouncycastle-java's DSTU7624Mac throws on non-block-aligned input, so it structurally cannot corroborate this case - see DECISIONS.md D-54.
